description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for a Linux-based embedded system, including image validation, upgrade procedures, partition handling, and configuration management.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and layout of a firmware image before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing image partitions and updating UUIDs.

methods.name: bcm27xx_set_root_part
methods.description: Sets the root partition UUID in configuration files based on a stored value.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from a backup to the target device during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_restore_backup
methods.description: Restores backup configurations from a tar archive.
